# fw vram

> Reference of the fw vram command: Estimate llama.cpp VRAM, SWA KV cache and the -ngl layer split. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/vram/

Estimate llama.cpp VRAM, SWA KV cache and the -ngl layer split

## Usage

```bash
fw vram [--vram-gb 12] [--model-gb 5.5] [--layers 32] [--ctx 16384] [--swa-layers 0] [--kv-type q8_0]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--vram-gb` | `12` |
| `--model-gb` | `5.5` |
| `--layers` | `32` |
| `--ctx` | `16384` |
| `--swa-layers` | `0` |
| `--kv-type` |  |
